verdict.rationale: Marlin's own docs say it generates a "fully referenced report" that includes references, and a customer testimonial praises the quantity and quality of cited information and its use of primary sources. However, nothing shows that every substantive claim carries an inline citation that traces to a specific source, or how a user verifies a claim against that source. Missing for 10: documented per-claim inline citation mechanics, source linking or traceability for verification, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can see citations for every substantive claim so I can verify it against the underlying source

citations.quote: From a fully referenced report to PowerPoint slides, everything is automatically generated
Everything from the main body to appendices, references, and presentation slides is automatically generated
